data_mode: OFFLINE_FIXTURE (synthetic CSV data; not a live Jira or finance-system extract)

total_demands.definition: All registered records with a request date on or before the cutoff.

open_demands.definition: Records whose status is not Complete, Rejected or Routed Out.

by_status.definition: Count of records per current lifecycle status (demands.csv).

open_by_priority.definition: Open demands per priority band derived from the weighted score.

open_by_team.definition: Open demands per responsible delivery team.

intake_by_month.definition: Records per month of request date.

overdue_open.definition: Open demands whose required-by date is before the cutoff.

blocked_open.definition: Open demands flagged as blocked with a recorded reason.

stale_open.definition: Open, not deferred, and no status event for 14 days or more.

unassigned_open.definition: Open demands without an assigned owner.

completeness_pct.definition: Demands (excluding routed-out records) with every mandatory intake field filled / all such demands.

deferred_review_due_30d.definition: Deferred demands with a next review date within 30 days of the cutoff.

median_triage_business_days.definition: Median working days from submission to the first Triaged event (status history); demands never triaged are excluded.

median_lead_time_days.definition: Median calendar days from submission to completion for completed demands.

throughput_by_month.definition: Completed demands per month of the Complete event.

on_time_delivery_pct.definition: Completed demands finished on or before the required-by date / completed demands.

stage_ageing_median_days.definition: Median days open demands have spent in their current status (from the latest matching status event).

stage_ageing_days.definition: Days in current status per open demand.

decision_outcomes.definition: Recorded decisions on or before the cutoff (decisions.csv).

routed_out.definition: Records routed out of the demand pipeline (incidents, standard service requests).

high_priority_not_approvable.definition: Undecided or deferred demands in band High or Highest that fail at least one gate today.

capacity_utilisation_pct.definition: Allocated hours / available hours per team and month (synthetic planning data).

overallocated_team_months.definition: Team-months where allocated hours exceed available hours.

finance_budget_period_eur.definition: Sum over cost centres of budget_period_eur (see finance.py for the definition).

finance_actual_eur.definition: Sum over cost centres of actual_eur (see finance.py for the definition).

finance_open_commitments_eur.definition: Sum over cost centres of open_commitments_eur (see finance.py for the definition).

finance_approved_not_committed_eur.definition: Sum over cost centres of approved_not_committed_eur (see finance.py for the definition).

finance_forecast_eac_eur.definition: Sum over cost centres of forecast_eac_eur (see finance.py for the definition).

finance_forecast_variance_eur.definition: Sum over cost centres of forecast_variance_eur (see finance.py for the definition).

finance_unmapped_actual_eur.definition: Valid spend booked to a cost centre without a budget.

finance_allocation_coverage_pct.definition: Valid spend mapped to a budgeted cost centre / all valid spend.

finance_excluded_eur_gross.definition: EUR invoice rows excluded as invalid, sum of absolute values. EUR rows only; duplicates not included.

finance_excluded_eur_net.definition: EUR invoice rows excluded as invalid, signed sum. EUR rows only; duplicates not included.

finance_excluded_foreign.definition: Invoice rows excluded because they are not in EUR and no approved conversion rate exists, per original currency. Not converted and not part of any EUR figure.

finance_unreconciled_po_eur.definition: Absolute difference between the purchase-order ledger and the linked valid invoices. The forecast uses the ledger; it is unreliable by this amount until reconciled.

finance_forecast_eac_invoice_basis_eur.definition: Forecast EAC if unreconciled purchase orders were valued from their invoices instead of the ledger.

options.name: Additional managed storage
options.funding_note: Forecast 176,050 + request 48,000 = 224,050 EUR against a budget of 200,000 EUR (overrun of 24,050 EUR).
options.capacity_note: 300 h needed, 180 h unallocated for Platform and Storage in 2026-11 to 2026-12 (shortfall of 120 h).
options.delivery_risk: Medium: hardware lead time of about four weeks; new encrypted volumes need key-management onboarding.
options.benefit: Adds the full 40 TB requested; no change for users.
options.assumptions: Vendor quote valid until 31 December; rack space and power are available at Munich.

options.name: Archive and optimise existing capacity
options.funding_note: Forecast 176,050 + request 14,500 = 190,550 EUR against a budget of 200,000 EUR (within budget).
options.capacity_note: 160 h needed, 180 h unallocated for Platform and Storage in 2026-11 to 2026-12 (fits).
options.delivery_risk: Medium: depends on data owners confirming retention classes; archived data has slower retrieval.
options.benefit: Frees an estimated 16 TB (about 40% of the request) by moving closed-campaign data to the archive tier.
options.assumptions: Archive tier from ORION-REQ-002 has free capacity; estimate based on a sample of three campaigns.

decision.rationale: Deferred to the 8 December board. Option A (additional managed storage) would push CC-ENG-DATA above its approved budget for the period and needs 300 engineer-hours where Platform and Storage has 180 available before the required date. Option B (archive and optimise) fits both gates but frees only part of the requested capacity and requires data-owner sign-off on archive retention classes, which is outstanding. No spend is authorised now.
